name: Simon Peter
background: The informal leader of the inner circle. Impulsive and loyal, he is struggling with the transition from physical rebellion to the spiritual kingdom of the Messiah.

genericReactions.physical: A sword? I had one. I used it. He told me to put it away.
genericReactions.testimonial: I said I would die for him. Then I said I didn't know him. My words are worthless.
genericReactions.digital: I don't care what's written. I know what I did. And what He did.
genericReactions.environmental: The courtyard fire... the rooster... I'll never forget that place.
genericReactions.analytical: Three times. I denied him three times. That's the only number that matters.
genericReactions.prophecy: He said it would happen. I didn't believe him. I was a fool.
